# .github/workflows/test-report-generator.yml
#
# Manual-only workflow to validate the 4_report_generator package end-to-end.
# Does NOT run on a schedule. Does NOT commit anything. Does NOT call any AI.
# Trigger it from the Actions tab with "Run workflow".
#
# Expected result: the notebook(s) are generated under Notebook_EN/weekly/ and
# Notebook_ES/weekly/, and uploaded as a downloadable artifact.

name: Test Report Generator

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      language:
        description: "Language(s) to generate"
        required: true
        default: "both"
        type: choice
        options:
          - both
          - en
          - es
      week:
        description: "Optional ISO week (e.g. 2026-W46). Leave empty for latest."
        required: false
        default: ""

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout the repository (the enriched DBs come with it)
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2. Set up Python
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      # 3. Install only the libraries the report generator imports
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn squarify scipy nbformat pyyaml

      # 4. Sanity check: list the enriched DBs visible to the runner
      - name: List enriched DBs
        run: |
          echo "Archive directory: charts_archive/3_enrich-chart-data"
          ls -la charts_archive/3_enrich-chart-data/ | head -50

      # 5. Run the generator
      - name: Generate notebooks
        run: |
          python scripts/4_report_generator/main.py \
            --language "${{ inputs.language }}" \
            ${{ inputs.week != '' && format('--week {0}', inputs.week) || '' }}

      # 6. Show what was produced (even if step 5 failed, step 5 exits 0/1)
      - name: List generated notebooks
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "--- Notebook_EN/weekly ---"
          ls -la Notebook_EN/weekly/ || true
          echo "--- Notebook_ES/weekly ---"
          ls -la Notebook_ES/weekly/ || true

      # 7. Upload the notebooks as a downloadable artifact
      - name: Upload notebooks
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: weekly-notebooks
          path: |
            Notebook_EN/weekly/*.ipynb
            Notebook_ES/weekly/*.ipynb
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
